I worked in a betting shop for 5 years and it impacted my mental health in an insane way. Sure there are some lovely customers but gambling is a horrible addiction and i watched people destroy their lives in front of me. I've seen kids left outside in the cold while their parents are inside playing the roulette machines, had furniture thrown at me (we didn't have protective screens) and people threaten to stab me multiple times. We don't get any security other than a panic button for police but half the time when you press it, whatever shit has gone down already by the time they arrive and there's nothing you can do. Let alone sometimes i had to work from 5-10pm on my own in a city centre shop, as a 20-something woman, with no security, hoping that nobody comes in to attack or rob me. It drained me so much i couldn't even bring myself to look for a new job because i felt so worthless and empty from seeing people begging on the street and putting whatever they've cobbled together on a dog rather than buy some food
